install_mac_important: Mac users {#b}must{/b} use Prism Launcher (or MultiMC) to be able to use Simple Voice Chat. Macs require apps to ask for permission to use the microphone, and since vanilla Minecraft doesn't use the microphone, no mods can request that permission either. Follow this guide to install Simple Voice Chat with Prism Launcher.
install_prism_update_p1: The easiest way to update is to go through the steps below again and create a new profile for METAcraft from the newest METAcraft.zip link.
install_prism_update_p2: You can also update manually in Prism Launcher if you know how. Download new versions of the mods and replace the jar files. Then change Minecraft and Fabric Loader to 0.19.2 or later.
install_prism_guide_intro: This guide is primarily for Prism Launcher, but the instructions are the same for MultiMC.
install_prism_skip_note: If you've already used Prism Launcher before, you can skip steps 1 & 2.
install_prism_step2_title: 2. Log in with your Microsoft account
install_prism_step2_p1: Press "Accounts" in the top right corner.
install_prism_step2_alt1: Press Profiles in the top right corner
install_prism_step2_p2: Add your account by logging in with your Microsoft account. Follow the instructions from Prism Launcher.
install_prism_step3_p2: Copy and paste the following link:
install_prism_step4_body: Select METAcraft and then choose "Launch" to start the game.
install_prism_step5_body: The first time you use Simple Voice Chat, you need to configure it by choosing which microphone and speaker the mod should use. To do this, press the 'V' key on your keyboard. Then select 'Next'.
install_prism_step5_p2: Then follow the instructions to finish configuring Simple Voice Chat. If you're on Mac, see below as you'll need to grant microphone access.
install_prism_step6_body: {#b}Important{/b} that you don't forget this step if you're on Mac. This gives Minecraft permission to use the microphone.
install_windows_download_cta: Click here to download the installer! (Windows)
install_windows_after_download: Then launch the exe program and follow the instructions there.
install_linux_download_cta: Click here to download the installer! (Linux)
install_linux_after_download: Then launch the jar program and follow the instructions there.
rules_description_pre: Thank you for wanting to be part of METAcraft's amazing community! For everyone's enjoyment, we've written some simple rules that everyone is expected to follow, which apply on all our Minecraft servers as well as on Discord.
rules_description_bold: {#b}By playing on the server you agree to follow the rules!{/b}
rules_general_p1: METAcraft has a wide variety of players with different ways of playing Minecraft. That's why there are also a variety of rules so that everyone can have fun and take part in the parts of the server they want.
rules_general_p2: In text chat and voice chat on both Minecraft and Discord, the following rules apply:
rules_general_li1: Be polite and respectful towards other players.
rules_general_li2_pre: On the server we adhere to
rules_general_li3: Avoid promoting other servers or services. Spam, advertising and unwanted links are not allowed.
rules_cheating_p1: {#b}Cheating is not allowed{/b} on any of METAcraft's servers. If you cheat you may be banned from the server and barred from participating in events.
rules_cheating_p3: Ask someone on the METAcraft team if you're unsure whether something counts as cheating or not.
rules_machines_p1: METAcraft keeps as many technical details from vanilla Minecraft as possible, and it's allowed to exploit these to, for example, build machines, farm mobs, and break bedrock.
rules_machines_p2: {#b}Avoid generating excessive lag as much as possible.{/b} You're not alone on the server, and if it affects performance you may be asked to turn off your machine and scale back animal breeding.
rules_machines_p3: Make sure to minimize the number of blocks and lights that change when you use your machine. Ask someone knowledgeable on the METAcraft team if you're unsure whether your machine is lag-friendly.
rules_survival_p1: {#b}In the Survival world{/b} civilized play applies. That means:
rules_survival_li1: {#b}PVP, theft and griefing are forbidden.{/b} It's allowed to sneak around people's bases, peek in their chests, and play pranks on them, but you may not destroy or steal anything. If you want something, ask first.
rules_survival_li2: {#b}Try to follow good Minecraft etiquette.{/b} We won't force anyone to fix creeper holes and floating blocks after themselves, but if you happen to destroy someone else's base you should help repair it.
campus_join_build_night: Join us for a build night!
campus_dream_p1: You've heard of {#a href=|https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Build_the_Earth|}Build the Earth{/a}. You might remember that Karlsruhe Institute of Technology built {#a href=|https://campus-kit.de/|}their entire campus{/a} in Minecraft. {#a href=|https://www.planetminecraft.com/project/world-of-worlds-3137794/|}This guy has built way too many cities{/a} and someone should do something about it.
campus_dream_p2: We're also not the first to try to build KTH Campus in Minecraft, but we're definitely the ones who have {#b}built the best{/b} and {#b}gotten the furthest{/b}. You're probably familiar with the triangle spanning from the F building to Nymble to the subway entrance as {#a href=|/smp/map|}the Survival server's world spawn{/a} for two school years, but now we want to go a step further and achieve something that's {#b}never{/b} been done before: we want to see {#b}the ENTIRE KTH Campus recreated in Minecraft.{/b}
campus_teamwork_p1: First we use Google Maps (Street View) and Google Earth to make sure the buildings are to scale. Then we build the interior, partly based on public floor plans. But how do we find out about the interior design, especially rooms behind closed doors?
campus_teamwork_p2: No one at KTH knows every room, but we all know a small part of campus that we personally visit often. That's why we need help from ALL students at KTH, if we want to represent KTH "at its best" from as many angles as possible. Maybe you'd like to take some extra time to make sure your section's room is extra neat and detailed?
campus_teamwork_p3: If we succeed with the project, it's not entirely impossible that our work gets noticed by KTH itself...
campus_build_nights_intro: Build nights are the best (and currently only) way to contribute to the project! Come chat with other people while you build to get instant feedback plus tips and advice. Below you'll find the schedule for all planned build nights (as well as all that have already happened!)
campus_join_placeholder_h2: here I would have explained how to contribute...

event_memory_p1: Inspired by professional productions like {#i}Minecraft Championships{/i}, METAcraft's events strive to crank the fun factor up to 11 with the best games we can come up with.
event_memory_p2: Come fight to the death in Ultra Hardcore, build a mural in METAplace, or challenge each other to a Parkour Race! With dozens of players joining every event, we promise there's never a dull moment when you play here!
event_memory_p3: No matter how good you are at PVP, or if you prefer less intense events, we're sure to have something for you! And if against all odds you're still unsatisfied, contact us on Discord, or {#a href=|/sok|}help us get better...{/a}
event_norequirement_p1: Unlike our {#a href=|/smp|}survival server{/a} and {#a href=|/campus|}"build campus" project{/a}, these events are completely public, so you do {#b}not{/b} need to be (or know) a KTH student to participate!
event_norequirement_p2: Participating in METAcraft's events doesn't require any time investment either. You don't need to have played on METAcraft before, you just join the server during the event, and leave whenever you want!
event_norequirement_p3: However, everyone needs to follow {#a href=|/rules|}the rules{/a}, so that everyone has a good time and no one cheats.
event_tl_hex4_p1: Hexathlon returned during DESCmas LAN with six minigames! Streamed live where our 3 beloved commentators competed with each other for the first time, swapping POVs!
event_tl_youtube_vod: Live VOD on our YouTube channel
event_tl_metalan_p1: During Ettans LAN, the section's first UHC tournament since 2023 was held! We started with a solo match as a warm-up, followed by a solo match and a team match with prizes. {#ign}Hynnd{/ign} took home the win in the solo match, while {#ign}Hynnd{/ign}, {#ign}222LiamWK{/ign} and {#ign}Ahara{/ign} won the team match.
event_tl_spelkvall_p1: During the Game Night with QN and DESC, we played several casual UHC matches without prizes or recording. It mostly served as a warm-up and test run ahead of the real UHC tournament on September 20th, but the matches were still full of excitement!
event_tl_hex3_p1: No CCLAN, but Hexathlon returns with FIVE new games, streamed live with 3 commentators!
event_tl_hex2_p1: The fan favorite makes its return with 3 new games and 3 old ones!
event_tl_hex1_p1: Sweden's biggest Minecraft minigame tournament took place during CCLAN, an annual gathering between several Swedish colleges and universities! Players from all over the country competed in 6 different solo minigames, and while competing they could also earn points for their school.
event_tl_hex1_p2: According to the CCLAN feedback form, Minecraft Hexathlon was the most popular of all the weekend's tournaments. It was also METAcraft's first livestreamed event, with a VOD available in the link below.
event_tl_campusbattle_p1: Students at KIT (Karlsruhe Institute of Technology) in Germany had also built their campus in Minecraft, so naturally we challenged them to a minigame tournament!
event_tl_campusbattle_p2: This event consisted of basically the same minigames as Minecraft Hexathlon three days later, so it also served the purpose of a test run for our next event.
event_tl_metaplace_p1: Over 7 days, all players could place blocks on a 128x128 canvas (with a cooldown), in the style of Reddit's r/place. There were also daily updates, events and introductions of new blocks. In total {#b}65,501{/b} blocks were placed by {#b}58{/b} unique players during the whole event.
event_tl_metaplace_p2: Starting from day 2, you could choose a section affiliation. Data placed {#b}40,389{/b} blocks, Media placed {#b}22,841{/b} blocks, and the remaining {#b}2,271{/b} were from unidentified players.
event_tl_metaplace_p3: During the "data vs media" event on day 5, Data won by a margin of {#b}81{/b} blocks (3049 vs 2968).
event_tl_survgames_p1: To celebrate recreating (a subset of) KTH Campus in Minecraft, the build was inaugurated with classic Survival Games matches taking place right on Campus! META was booked for the event, but many also joined online.
event_tl_survgames_p2: Several matches were played, and the top 10 best players (along with their total score) at the end of the night were {#ign}Bullen13{/ign} (186), {#ign}Hynnd{/ign} (156), {#ign}Ahara{/ign} (155), {#ign}PupuOSJ{/ign} (123), {#ign}viggo003{/ign} (73), {#ign}Alleee_{/ign} (72), {#ign}hexalotl{/ign} (60), {#ign}Jonla{/ign} (59), {#ign}Benjaneb{/ign} (55), {#ign}BOT_Bond{/ign} (32).
event_tl_survgames_p3: Prizes were given to the top 5 players who were there in person.
event_tl_metauhc_p1: Ultra Hardcore meets META at dJubileet's METAhäng: DESCathon! We played a total of four matches: a solo match as a warm-up, followed by a solo match and a team match with prizes, and to finish off, a red vs blue deathmatch without prizes.
event_tl_metauhc_p2: {#ign}Alvinn8{/ign} took home the win in the solo match, and the team match was won by {#ign}Ahara{/ign}, {#ign}Hynnd{/ign} and {#ign}Plotimus{/ign}.
home_intro: We're a Minecraft community primarily aimed at students in the Computer Science and Media Technology programs at KTH. Step into an active community with exciting events and regular updates with new content. There's always something fun to do here — no matter your playstyle and experience!
home_three_parts: METAcraft consists of three parts, all equally amazing and made with love. Click below to read more about them!
home_gamesquare_survival: An ordinary multiplayer experience in an unusual world!
home_gamesquare_pvp: Compete with & against your friends in exciting tournaments and other events!
home_flex_body: ...and bring METAcraft with you wherever you go! Put on your section's apparel and represent your section, no matter which server you play on. Download the official cerise resource pack to add the color cerise to your game, just like on the Survival server! All of this is free to download on the website.
home_vc_pre: The most fun way to communicate with other players is to do it directly in the game world! With the {#a href=|https://modrinth.com/plugin/simple-voice-chat|}Simple Voice Chat{/a} mod you can use your voice to talk to others, and skip typing out your chat messages! We've made it super easy for you to get started, just follow the link below!
home_help_us_pre: METAcraft is run by students, for students — none of this would be possible without contributions from students like you and me. If you find the above-mentioned projects interesting, don't hesitate to {#b}apply to the project group today!{/b} You'll get to take part in METAcraft's development directly, and enjoy exclusive fika and activities!
home_help_us_cta: Apply to the project group NOW!
features_shops_p1: Set up your own shops with the shop block, crafted according to the following recipe (any color of planks and wool):
features_shops_p2: The block then needs to be placed on top of a {#b}barrel{/b} that stores input/output. Once you've done that, you can right-click the shop block to start configuring your trades.
features_wrench_p1: Make block entities such as chests, furnaces and dispensers movable by right-clicking with the wrench:
features_drill_p1: A drill that can drill through the bedrock at the top of the nether:
features_anvil: {#b}Anvils{/b} don't increase the XP cost when repairing or renaming an item, and the maximum XP cost never goes above 39 levels.
features_anvil_note: This means {#i}Mending{/i} isn't as necessary as in vanilla, since there's no upper limit on how many times you can repair an item.
features_villager: {#b}Villager trading{/b} on the server uses {#a href=|https://minecraft.wiki/w/Villager_Trade_Rebalance|}Villager Trade Rebalance{/a}.
features_silence: {#b}Mobs can be silenced{/b} by naming them "Silence me" with a nametag.
features_silence_note: This can be useful for, for example, secret bases.
features_portal: {#b}Nether portals{/b} can be activated in any size and shape you want, not just rectangular.
features_sand: {#b}Sand can be renewed{/b} by killing Husks (desert zombies), which now also spawn in Desert Temples.
features_pet: {#b}Pets{/b} cannot be hurt by their owner or other players the pet trusts. As the owner, you can choose which other players the pet should trust by sneaking and right-clicking the pet. If a pet trusts you, you can decide whether it should sit or stand, and the pet will never attack you.
features_parrots: {#b}Parrots{/b} can be bred and healed with seeds!
features_lead: {#b}Tamed pets{/b} that are standing and leashed animals (or boats and everything they contain) will follow the player through portals.
features_minecarts: {#b}Minecarts{/b} have had their speed increased from 8 blocks/second to 40 blocks per second. By using ice, packed ice or blue ice, the speed can be increased by 5, 10 and 20 blocks per second respectively. If you need the old mechanics for, say, a machine, you can always convert them into "Slowcarts" by placing them alone in a crafting grid.
features_statue: {#b}Armor stands{/b} can be configured into different poses by using a book named "Statues" (capital S). {#a href=|https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nV9-_RacnoI|}See here for a tutorial!{/a}
features_mobhead1: {#b}All mobs have a chance to drop their head{/b} when killed by a player. {#a href=|https://wiki.vanillatweaks.net/More_Mob_Heads|}Click here for exact probabilities!{/a}
features_playerhead: {#b}Players always drop their head{/b} when killed by another player.
features_trader: {#b}Wandering Traders{/b} sell custom mini-blocks you can use to decorate your builds!
features_worldgen: {#b}World generation{/b} uses the datapacks {#a href=|https://modrinth.com/datapack/clifftree/gallery|}Cliff under a Tree{/a}, {#a href=|https://modrinth.com/datapack/wabi-sabi-structures/gallery|}Wabi-Sabi Structures{/a} and {#a href=|https://modrinth.com/mod/towns-and-towers/gallery|}Towns and Towers{/a} with some private modifications from us. They give the world a more unique feel without affecting gameplay or progression.
features_end: {#b}The End{/b} uses {#a href=|https://modrinth.com/datapack/nullscape|}Nullscape{/a} and {#a href=|https://modrinth.com/mod/mes-moogs-end-structures/gallery|}Moog's End Structures{/a} in an attempt to make the dimension a bit less boring. Watch out, phantoms now spawn in the End! You also won't need to feel like you have to run to the world border just to find an elytra. We've also added {#a href=|https://modrinth.com/datapack/elytra-vaults-atlasplays|}Elytra Vaults{/a} and made sure there are shulkers left in every end city.
features_feedback: Want to add or remove features? Post on discord in {#a href=|https://discord.com/channels/1125493460976271370/1125493461496381553|}#general{/a} and we can bring it up in {#a href=|https://discord.com/channels/1125493460976271370/1125493461496381553|}#polls{/a}!
smp_see_map: See the map of the world!
smp_add_voicechat: Add voice chat to the game!
smp_multiplayer_p1: A warm and helpful community awaits, with players from all backgrounds collaborating, building and exploring together. Find build partners, join events, or jump into spontaneous adventures.
smp_multiplayer_p2: Minecraft is most fun when many people play together. However, we understand that not everyone has time to play all the time, which is why we present...
smp_multiplayer_p3: {#b}METACRAFT MONDAYS{/b} every Monday at 7:00 PM we play together on the server! Whether you're a beginner or a veteran, come join fun activities, build projects and shared adventures. It's the perfect chance to meet new friends and experience the server at its best!
smp_classmates_p1: The server is open to {#i}all KTH students{/i}, and on top of that you can invite as many players as you want from outside KTH. Gather the whole Minecraft gang and set off on epic adventures — leave no one out!
smp_classmates_p2: It's easy to add a player as your +1. Instructions are shown on screen for the person you're adding, and both players need to be online.
smp_landscape_p1: We've fine-tuned the world a little to make exploring more exciting and rewarding. You can find amazing oases, ice caves, breathtaking savannas, and so much more, not to mention 30+ new structures for you to explore across all dimensions.
smp_landscape_p2: We've also implemented several functional and decorative changes to the game to improve your experience. That can be anything from Villager Trade Rebalance to the ability to silence mobs. {#a href=|/smp/features|}Read about all the differences here.{/a}
